Run additional iterations of a fitted MPCurve model

Source: R/07_mpcurve.R
do_mpcurve.Rd

Refines a fitted model by running additional coordinate-ascent variational iterations. Use this when the objective is still increasing at the iteration limit, or to explore a change in smoothing parameters.

Usage

do_mpcurve(
  object,
  iter = 1,
  lambda = NULL,
  S = NULL,
  tol = NULL,
  lambda_sd_prior_rate = NULL,
  lambda_min = NULL,
  lambda_max = NULL,
  sigma_min = NULL,
  sigma_max = NULL,
  tol_outer = NULL,
  freeze_unused_ordering = NULL,
  freeze_unused_ordering_threshold = NULL,
  freeze_feature = NULL,
  freeze_feature_weight_threshold = NULL,
  drop_unused_ordering = NULL,
  assignment_prior = NULL,
  ordering_alpha = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

object

An mpcurve object returned by fit_mpcurve(). Partition fits saved before version 0.3.0 require refitting with fit_mpcurve() before they can be continued.

iter

Integer >= 1. Maximum number of additional CAVI sweeps (single ordering) or exact T = 1 partition steps.

lambda

Optional positive smoothness value(s). A single-ordering fit accepts a scalar or length-d vector. A structural partition fit accepts a scalar, a length-d vector broadcast across orderings, a flattened length-d * M vector, or a d x M matrix; this resets lambda_mat before continuation.

S

Optional known measurement standard deviations. If NULL, reuse the value stored on object. Supplying a new S is only allowed when it matches the stored specification.

tol

Optional relative ELBO tolerance for single-ordering CAVI. If NULL, reuse the stored value.

lambda_sd_prior_rate

Optional positive rate for the induced exponential prior on 1 / sqrt(lambda_j). If NULL, the stored control value is reused. Use 0 to remove this penalty.

lambda_min, lambda_max

Optional positive bounds for lambda_j. If NULL, reuse the stored values.

sigma_min, sigma_max

Optional positive bounds for sigma_j^2. If NULL, reuse the stored values.

tol_outer

For partition fits only: relative objective tolerance used after annealing. If NULL, reuse the stored value.

freeze_unused_ordering, freeze_unused_ordering_threshold, freeze_feature, freeze_feature_weight_threshold, drop_unused_ordering

Deprecated; leave as NULL. Explicit values are ignored with a warning.

assignment_prior, ordering_alpha

Deprecated; leave as NULL. Continuation uses the fitted partition prior. Explicit values are ignored with a warning.

verbose

Logical. Print per-iteration progress?

Value

An updated mpcurve object with refined estimates and extended convergence traces.

Details

Fitting resumes from the stored posterior and parameter estimates. A single-ordering fit appends to $elbo_trace. A multi-ordering fit refines all \(M\) orderings, trajectories, and feature assignments at temperature \(T=1\), appending to $objective_history and $temperature_history.

With unchanged model settings, the additional objective values should be nondecreasing up to numerical tolerance. Changing a smoothing prior or parameter bounds can change the objective or feasible parameter range; assess convergence within the new run in that case.
